component.name: DyoSnap
component.summary: Screenshots and screen recordings, saved locally

description.p: A light screenshot and screen-recording app for Wayland desktops (GNOME, KDE Plasma). Every capture is saved on your computer and copied to the clipboard, so you can paste it right away.
Annotate screenshots in the built-in editor. Every change updates the clipboard. Videos stay crisp and small. No account, no cloud upload.

ul.li: Capture an area, a window or the whole screen
Record the screen as a video
Edit and annotate in the built-in editor
Everything is saved locally and copied to the clipboard

screenshot.caption: Capture and annotate a screenshot on KDE Plasma

description.p: Linux: .deb and .rpm packages, recording with OpenH264 when ffmpeg has no x264, and a new signing certificate on macOS.
Renamed from LightSnap to DyoSnap. Extra save folders with their own shortcuts and a tabbed Preferences window.
Many Linux improvements: area selection, a red frame around the record area, a recording control bar and a tray icon.
